_readme: Costs that a prefab house price usually leaves out, for the 'full cost' calculator on hisomer.si. Each entry in 'items': key, label (Slovenian), unit ('EUR' = per house, 'EUR/m2' = per m2 of the stated area, 'EUR/kW', 'EUR/m2_neto' = per m2 of net heated area), value OR {min, max}, optional 'typical', 'vat' ('incl' = DDV included, 'excl' = DDV excluded, 'unknown' = source does not say), applies (when it applies), confidence (high = official tariff or legal text; medium = several market sources agree; low = single market source or forum), source_ids (see data/stroski-viri.md) and as_of (date of the source data). 'komunalni_prispevek' is separate: the formula, per-municipality amounts for a reference case and a national range. The reference case is a 600 m2 building plot and a house with 150 m2 net floor area; komunalni prispevek is legally charged on BRUTO floor area (BTP), so 150 m2 neto is converted to BTP = 180 m2 with the 1.2 factor the odloki themselves use when BTP is unknown. Amounts in 'calc_600_180' were computed by us from the odlok values (formula below), at the odlok's prices without indexation, connecting to roads, water, sewer and public areas (plus waste where the odlok charges it), but not to gas or district heating. 'vsevem_600_200' amounts are a third-party calculator's results for 600 m2 plot / 200 m2 BTP, all equipment types connected. Money in EUR. Accessed 2026-10-19.

reference_case.btp_note: BTP = neto x 1.2 (fallback rule in Koper and Ptuj odloki, sources kp-koper, kp-ptuj)

komunalni_prispevek.label: Komunalni prispevek
komunalni_prispevek.formula: KP = sum over equipment i of (A_parcela x Cpo(i) x Dpo + A_BTP x Cto(i) x Dto x Fn) x psz(i)
komunalni_prispevek.formula_notes: Cpo/Cto = EUR per m2 of plot / per m2 BTP for each equipment type, set in each municipality's odlok. Dpo + Dto = 1 (e.g. 0.3/0.7 in Koper, Ptuj, Ljubljana, Novo mesto; 0.5/0.5 in Maribor, Celje, Kranj, Tolmin). Fn = faktor namembnosti for CC-SI 1110 enostanovanjske stavbe, set by the odlok (1.0 Koper, 0.7 Ptuj). psz = prispevna stopnja zavezanca, 100 % if the odlok sets none. Roads and public areas are always charged; water, sewer, gas, district heating only if the house connects. Framework: Uredba 20/19 under ZUreP-2; replaced by Uredba Ur. l. RS 53/26 (in force 28. 3. 2026, under ZUreP-3). Existing municipal odloki were adopted under the 2019 rules.
komunalni_prispevek.applies: Always for a new house that needs a gradbeno dovoljenje; assessed by the municipality before the permit. Amount depends on municipality and, in some, on the zone (Koper has 5 road zones).

national_range.basis: vsevem.si, 204 of 212 municipalities, 600 m2 plot / 200 m2 BTP, all equipment, odlok prices without indexation; min Kobilje, max Piran, typical = average

komunalni_prispevek.share_of_investment_note: 24ur (8. 1. 2026, quoting an architect): komunalni prispevek is typically about 10 % of the investment excluding the plot.

municipalities.note: min/max = Fn 0.7 vs 1.0 (Fn for 1110 not confirmed). Odlok 2021 prices; vsevem estimates +33 % with indexation to 2025. 24ur (Jan 2026) reports almost 19,600 EUR for 200 m2 / 600 m2. Indexed x 1.25-1.33.

min/max = Fn 0.7 vs 1.0. The 2024 amendment deleted the psz article; the old psz rates are used here, so treat as uncertain. Indexed 11,000-14,000: 24ur reports 14-18k for MB, CE, KR; the psz article was repealed in MUV 6/2024.
Fn 1 (default; odlok's Fn table not seen). Without gas and district heating. Indexed x 1.15-1.3.
Fn 1 (default). Cpo/Cto equal to the national Pravilnik averages. Indexed x 1.15-1.3.

Range over the 5 road zones (CES1 lowest, CES4 highest; CES3 = 27,531). Fn 1, psz 100 %, Dpo/Dto 0.3/0.7, read from the odlok. Used as the indexed figure (vsevem: +49 % with indexation of the 2019 odlok); 24ur suggests the lower road-class values are closer to what is charged.
Fn 1. Vsevem estimates +33 % with indexation to 2025. Indexed x 1.15-1.3.
Computed from the odlok (Fn 0.7, Dpo/Dto 0.3/0.7, psz 95/75/51/80 %). Vsevem's figure is higher; difference not explained. Kept as is; matches 24ur.

komunalni_prispevek.indexation_note: Assessments are indexed (GZS "ostala nizka gradnja" index from the odlok's adoption year): vsevem estimates +33 % for Ljubljana 2021-2025 and +49 % for Koper's 2019 odlok. The calculator uses "indexed"; calc_600_180 stays the unindexed odlok figure. Uredba 53/26 (in force 28. 3. 2026) may change the rules.

items.label: Izhodišča / idejna zasnova (IZP, DPP, IDZ)
items.applies: Before the permit project; often part of the architect's package.

items.label: Projekt za gradbeno dovoljenje (DGD)
items.applies: Always (needed for gradbeno dovoljenje). Some prefab makers include it in the price; check the offer.

items.label: Projekt za izvedbo (PZI)
items.applies: Needed to build and for the Eko sklad sNES+ subsidy (area is taken from PZI). Prefab makers often draw their own execution plans.

items.label: Celotna projektna dokumentacija (IDZ, DGD, PZI, PID)
items.applies: Use instead of the separate items when the visitor has no documentation in the house price. Jelovica values the DGD+PZI it includes at up to 15,000 EUR incl. DDV (jelovica-paket); NOAH buyers without included documentation pay about 8,700 EUR for DGD+PZI+PID (mhe-noah).

items.label: Geodetski načrt
items.applies: Needed as a base for DGD.

items.label: Geološko-geomehansko poročilo
items.applies: Including a test pit. Commonly required for the foundation design. Difficult ground (slope, fill, high groundwater) can cost far more.

items.label: Mnenja in soglasja
items.applies: Opinions from elektro, vodovod, water authority, telecom during the permit process.

items.label: Gradbeni nadzor
items.applies: Mandatory supervision during construction; usually 1.5-3 % of the build value (zurnal-nadzor). Confidence medium-high.

items.label: Projekt izvedenih del (PID)
items.applies: About 20 % of the DGD fee. projekt_paket already includes PID, so add this only when the documentation is in the house price.

items.label: Elaborat za vpis v kataster stavb
items.applies: After construction, for the entry in the building cadastre. Always added.

items.label: Zakoličba objekta
items.applies: Staking out the house on the plot before building. Always added.

items.label: Varnostni načrt
items.applies: Safety plan for the building site. A safety coordinator is usually not needed for a house under 350 m2. Always added.

items.label: Upravna taksa za gradbeno dovoljenje
items.applies: 271.80 EUR + 0.01 % of the building value above 42,000 EUR + 4.50 EUR for the application; about 297 EUR for a 250,000 EUR house. Young families solving their housing problem may be exempt. Confidence medium-high.

items.label: Energetska izkaznica
items.applies: Needed for the uporabno dovoljenje. Always added.

items.label: Izračun PHPP
items.applies: Passive-house calculation required for the Eko sklad sNES+ subsidy; added only when sNES+ is chosen.

items.label: Omrežnina za priključno moč, 11 kW (3 x 16 A)
items.applies: One-off fee to the network operator for a new connection; 75.61 EUR/kW without DDV at low voltage. Building the physical connection (cable, meter cabinet) is extra and not covered here.

items.label: Omrežnina za priključno moč, 17 kW (3 x 25 A)
items.applies: Typical for a house with a heat pump. Same notes as 11 kW.

items.label: Omrežnina za priključno moč, 22 kW (3 x 32 A)
items.applies: Larger houses, EV charging.

items.label: Omrežnina za priključno moč (na kW)
items.applies: Low voltage (NN), 2026 tariff.

items.label: Izgradnja elektro priključka (projekt, soglasje, PMO, kabel, izkop)
items.applies: The investor finances and builds the physical connection (egor-izgradnja-prikljucka); a 2021 forum example totals 3,680 EUR including 1,067 EUR omrežnina. Always added next to the omrežnina. Confidence medium-low.

items.label: Vodovodni priključek
items.applies: If a public water main is near the plot. Covers the meter shaft, meter, montaža, the operator's survey and the trench. Varies with distance to the main.

items.label: Kanalizacijski priključek
items.applies: If public sewer is available. The user pays for building the house sewer to the public line and its supervision.

items.label: Mala komunalna čistilna naprava (MKČN), vgrajena
items.applies: Instead of the sewer connection where no public sewer exists. Device about 5,700 EUR (ROTO MBBR 4-6 PE, pr-merkur-mkcn) plus excavation, installation and soakaway 2,000-4,000 EUR (mojmojster-mkcn-2026). Municipal co-funding (e.g. Koper 40 %, max 1,500 EUR) is mostly for existing buildings, so it is not subtracted.

items.label: Telekomunikacijski priključek
items.applies: Fibre or copper connection to the house. Always added. No priced source found; rough estimate from the research.

items.label: Priključki skupaj (elektrika, voda, kanalizacija, internet)
items.applies: Electricity (omrežnina and build), water, sewer and telecom together. Off-grid with an MKČN: 13,000-18,000 EUR.

items.label: Temeljna plošča (toplotno izolirana)
items.applies: Per m2 of gross slab area (about the ground-floor footprint plus walls), insulated slab as prefab makers require it. Range = sum of MojMojster's 2026 line items: slab 25 cm 80-120, XPS 2 x 10 cm 33-47, hidroizolacija 18-35, podložni beton 6-12, installations under the slab 15-40 (152-254). Its headline 130-200 and Primerjam's 125-188 sit at the low end; real quotes (forum 180-215, and a 2025 quote the site owner received of at least 220 per gross m2) sit in the upper half. Excavation and gravel bed are extra (zemeljska dela). Only when the maker's price is 'brez temeljne plošče'. A bare uninsulated slab is 80-130 EUR/m2.

items.label: Temeljna plošča, primer 100 m²
items.applies: 100 m2 of insulated slab at the line-item range, without excavation and gravel bed.

items.label: Izkop in tamponsko nasutje pod ploščo
items.applies: Per m2 of slab: excavation 9-14.5 plus a 50 cm gravel bed 20-32. Terrain changes it a lot; covered by the zemeljska_dela line in the calculator.

items.label: Izkop in zemeljska dela
items.applies: Easy ground 6,000-10,000 EUR (typical 8,000); unknown ground 6,000-20,000; difficult ground (rock, slope) 20,000 EUR or more, counted as 20,000-30,000. Build-up for a ~140 m2 footprint: excavation ~1,200, haul-off and landfill 1,000-1,500, gravel bed 2,100-2,500, trenches ~1,400, geotextile and compaction ~400, plus DDV. Confidence medium-low.

items.label: Zunanja ureditev (dovoz, tlakovanje, zelenice)
items.applies: Basic case (60 m2 asphalt, 20 m2 terrace, 80 m panel fence at ~50 EUR/m, 300 m2 lawn, stormwater soakaway) about 10,000 EUR; a nicer one 20,000-25,000 EUR. Confidence low-medium.

items.label: Eko sklad subvencija za sNES+ novogradnjo (odbitek)
items.applies: Negative item (subsidy). Javni poziv 105SUB-sNESOB23, open, amended 12. 3. 2026. Per m2 of net heated and ventilated area, max 150 m2 for a detached house (120 m2 for a semi-detached/row house). 170/150 EUR/m2 group I (natural insulation + wooden windows), 130/110 group II (mineral), 100/90 group III (synthetic), for QH <= 10 / <= 15 kWh/m2a. Capped at 30 % of eligible costs; for a turnkey build eligible costs are at most 50 % of the contract value. Requires PHPP, QH and QK <= 15 kWh/m2a, n50 <= 0.6, recuperation >= 80 %, rainwater tank >= 6 m3, PV covering the building's electricity, >= 70 % renewables. PV itself is not eligible (Borzen PV subsidy can be added). -10 EUR/m2 if PV connection was refused.

items.label: DDV za stanovanjsko hišo
items.applies: 9.5 % if the house is a stanovanjski objekt for permanent living 'kot del socialne politike': uporabna površina (sum of living rooms) <= 250 m2 for an enostanovanjska stavba, and the supply/construction is invoiced directly to the investor as a construction service (SKD F). Otherwise 22 %. For a prefab house sold with assembly to the investor this is the usual reading; a kit sold without assembly, and items like kitchens or built-in wardrobes, may be 22 %. Confirm with the maker or FURS.

docs_included.note: Lumar and Jelovica say DGD and PZI are included in the house price, so the calculator pre-ticks "documentation included" for their houses.
